items.title: 3 US Bank Stocks Facing The Biggest Fed Rate Test
items.summary: Inflation is still running hot, the Fed is talking tough on rates, and suddenly the quiet corners of US banks, insurers, and brokers look far more interesting than the latest high growth story. Moves in PCE and rate expectations can help or hurt different financial stocks in very different ways, which creates both risk and FOMO. This article walks through three large US financial stocks exposed to this inflation and rate shock and explains how the same macro headline can mean very different...
